## 1. Company Profile & Overview
Duyuf Al Rahman VIP (ضيوف الرحمن VIP) is a dedicated private chauffeur and pilgrim ground transportation service operating across Jeddah, Makkah, Madinah, Taif, and Riyadh in Saudi Arabia. The company provides professional, discreet, and reliable airport transfers, intercity transfers, and ziyarat tours for Umrah and Hajj pilgrims, visiting families, and executive travelers. Operating 24 hours a day, 7 days a week (24/7).

### Trust Signals & Verified Service Standards
- Genuine verified pilgrim feedback from travelers across the United Kingdom, Malaysia, Indonesia, Pakistan, Turkey, and the GCC.
- Modern sanitized fleet consisting of Toyota Camry, Mercedes-Maybach VIP, Hyundai Staria VIP, Hyundai H1 Royal, GMC Yukon XL VIP, Toyota HiAce VIP Minibus, and Toyota Coaster VIP Coach.
- Strict non-smoking policy enforced across all cabins.
- Verified courteous chauffeurs fluent in Arabic, English, Malay, and Urdu with local road expertise.
- 24/7 operations, dispatch monitoring, and round-the-clock customer support.

## 2. Core Value Proposition & Service Policies

### 2.1. 100% Pay on Arrival (Strictly Cash Only, Zero Prepayment Required)
Unlike platforms that require advance credit card payments or non-refundable deposits, Duyuf Al Rahman VIP operates on a 100% Pay-on-Arrival policy:
- Pilgrims complete their booking online or on WhatsApp and receive an immediate reference voucher (e.g., VIP-XXXXX).
- Payment is made directly to the chauffeur after the journey is completed and the customer reaches the requested destination hotel.
- Accepted payment methods: Strictly cash paid to the driver after the journey is completed and the customer reaches the requested destination in Saudi Riyals (SAR) or US Dollars (USD). Credit cards, debit cards, POS terminals, online payments, and bank transfers are not accepted.
- Zero deposit, zero advance card requirement.

### 2.2. Terminal Meet & Greet with Flight Radar Tracking
- For pickups at King Abdulaziz International Airport (KAIA / JED) in Jeddah and Prince Mohammad Bin Abdulaziz International Airport (MED) in Madinah:
- Chauffeurs arrive prior to flight touchdown with automated international flight radar tracking synchronized with real-time airport displays.
- Complimentary airport waiting time: 60 minutes starting from actual touchdown on the runway, with an extended buffer up to 90 minutes for international arrivals clearing customs and baggage.
- In case of flight delays or rescheduling, chauffeur schedule updates automatically at zero penalty.
- Chauffeur greets the pilgrim family outside arrivals with a personalized nameplate and assists with all luggage.

### 2.3. Transparent All-Inclusive Fixed Pricing
All fares quoted on the platform are fixed, guaranteed per vehicle, and include:
- Applicable taxes (VAT).
- All highway expressway tolls (including Haramain Expressway).
- Airport parking and terminal pick-up charges.
- Fuel and private chauffeur services.
- Zero surge pricing or unexpected surcharges.

### 2.4. Complimentary Amenities & Travel Policies
- Complimentary infant & child safety booster seats upon advance request.
- Complimentary 30 to 45 minutes stopover at Miqat Bir Ali (Masjid Dhu al-Hulayfah) or Miqat Qarn al-Manazil for Ihram and Niyyah.
- Free cancellation and rescheduling up to 24 hours prior to scheduled pickup time.
- High-performance climate control air conditioning built for Saudi weather.
- Dedicated deep luggage space accommodating full suitcase sets and official 5L Zamzam canisters.
- Chilled bottled drinking water provided on all journeys.
- USB-C and mobile device charging ports in all vehicles.

## 3. Fleet Categories & Specifications

### 3.1. Toyota Camry Executive (Executive Sedan)
- Passenger Capacity: Up to 4 passengers.
- Luggage Capacity: 3 large suitcases.
- Best suited for: Solo pilgrims, couples, or business travelers.

### 3.2. Mercedes-Maybach VIP (Presidential Luxury Sedan)
- Passenger Capacity: Up to 3 passengers.
- Luggage Capacity: 3 large suitcases.
- Best suited for: Ultra-luxury executive chauffeur, dignitaries, and VIP delegations.

### 3.3. Hyundai Staria VIP (Family Van)
- Passenger Capacity: Up to 7 passengers.
- Luggage Capacity: 6 large suitcases + carry-on bags.
- Best suited for: Pilgrim families traveling between Jeddah, Makkah, and Madinah with captain chairs.

### 3.4. Hyundai H1 Royal (Spacious Family MPV)
- Passenger Capacity: Up to 7 passengers.
- Luggage Capacity: 6-7 large suitcases.
- Best suited for: Family comfort and ample luggage room.

### 3.5. GMC Yukon XL VIP (Ultra-Luxury SUV)
- Passenger Capacity: Up to 7 passengers.
- Luggage Capacity: 8 large suitcases.
- Best suited for: VIP delegations, executives, and families seeking maximum cabin quietness and space.

### 3.6. Toyota HiAce VIP (Family & Group Minibus)
- Passenger Capacity: Up to 10 passengers.
- Luggage Capacity: 10-12 large suitcases.
- Best suited for: Large extended families, Umrah group packages, and tour groups.

### 3.7. Toyota Coaster VIP (Group Coach)
- Passenger Capacity: Up to 21 passengers.
- Luggage Capacity: 20 large suitcases.
- Best suited for: Large Umrah groups, delegations, and shared group transfers.

## 5. Booking & Reservation Procedure
1. Visit https://duyufalrahmanvip.com/booking or message WhatsApp +966567588261 / +966505316971.
2. Select pickup location, drop-off destination, date, time, passenger count, luggage count, and vehicle class.
3. System outputs guaranteed fixed price in SAR or selected currency.
4. Booking is confirmed instantly with unique reference number (e.g., VIP-74291).
5. Driver details (name, phone, vehicle plate) sent prior to departure.
6. Pay your driver in cash after the journey is completed and the customer reaches the requested destination.
